summary: Iter84 sales-tax regression: 14/14 backend HTTP tests pass (7 pre-existing + 7 new). Frontend UI verified end-to-end via Playwright — Bug1 pencil-edit-and-resave preserves per-line tax_id and does NOT double the total ($275 stays $275 after Save+reload), Bug2 liability delta = exact tax collected, TaxLibrary 'Linked payable' column present with 'Default' fallback, Record Sales Tax Payment dialog opens with all 4 required data-testids and correct pre-fill (Sales Tax Payable — $910.00, Cash and Bank auto-selected, amount=910.00), and Estimate editor regression preserves per-line tax on save+reload. All flows work as spec'd.

minor.issue: Sales Tax Payable balance can drift negative in test/dev orgs when tax-payments are recorded but invoices are later DELETEd (invoice DELETE reverses the CR JE but the corresponding DR from tax-payment stays). Consider disallowing invoice delete when a tax-payment references its accrual, OR cascade-reverse the payment. Not blocking release.

issues: Liability strip banner correctly hides when balance <= 0, but there is no zero-state message ('No sales tax due right now.') — user may wonder if the feature is even there when they open a fresh company
The right-hand Assistant panel auto-opens on every login and steals ~330px of viewport width on Sales Tax Center / Invoice Editor — consider a persisted collapsed state

action_items: OPTIONAL: add a friendlier zero-state to the Sales Tax Center banner slot when tax-liability total <= 0
OPTIONAL: guard invoice DELETE against orphaning a tax-payment JE (see minor backend issue) — root cause of negative STP balances observed in dev DB
critical_code_review_comments: posting_service.post_invoice_je: the peel-back logic (line_tax_total from lines, doc_level_tax = total_tax - line_tax_total) assumes the caller submits the ROLLED-UP tax on disk. If any non-frontend caller PATCHes with the raw echoed body without peeling, tax will inflate on repost. The frontend fix (InvoiceEditor.jsx line 145-147 peels before submitting) is correct, but the backend has no guard for the un-peeled case — external API/webhook consumers could still hit doubling. Consider a request-shape flag ('rolled_up_tax': true) or backend-side idempotency by re-computing tax strictly from lines.

sales_tax_liability endpoint filters to STP-tagged liability accounts by name/detail_type only. When a tax rate's payable_account_id points to a NON-STP liability account (the new feature), the banner will NOT count it — the tax collected is invisible in the Sales Tax Center. Recommend: include any account referenced as a payable_account_id on any tax doc in the liability rollup.

Invoice delete cascades reverse the invoice JE but not the linked tax-payment JE, leading to persistently negative STP balances in dev DB (currently -40 → -90 depending on test run). Add a link-cascade or refuse the delete when a payment references it.

rca of the issue: Both P0 bugs are fixed as claimed by the main agent for the standard frontend flow. Under the covers, Bug1 is fixed via cooperative frontend peel logic (InvoiceEditor.jsx lines 141-147 subtract Σ line.tax_amount from inv.tax on load so the resave sends the DOC-LEVEL residual, not the rolled-up figure). Verified: create $110, load in editor, click Save with no changes, refresh — total stays $110. Bug2 is fixed by the rewritten post_invoice_je (DR AR full-total, CR income per line, CR Sales Tax Payable) — verified balanced JE and GET /tax-liability returns exactly the collected tax after invoice creation.
